raw.description:
Please note: we can only consider UK-based candidates at this time. Please do not apply if you are not located in the UK. Start dates would be August 2026.

The multi-Oscar-winning creative Film & Episodic Studio, at Framestore has worked with some of the greatest storytellers in film today. Collaborating with directors and producers across the complete filmmaking process to help design, plan and create beautiful images, we focus on finding innovative creative solutions to support their vision and set new standards for visual effects in cinema.

Framestore combines talent and technology to bring life to everything we create. Driven by creativity and inspired by the future, we set out every day to reframe the possible.

The Role
As a Compositor at Framestore London, you're not just blending images; you're part of a creative conversation. Work closely with Compositing Leads, Compositing Supervisors, as well as, VFX Supervisors to figure out the best way to bring assigned shots to life. Your responsibilities include integrating 2D, 3D, and live-action elements to achieve high-end film visual effects standards.

Additionally, you’ll be responsible for:

  • Keeping the project on track by meeting schedules and project deadlines.

  • Maintaining open lines of communication with Production.

  • Balance the creative and technical elements of each shot, using your expertise in Nuke.


Job Requirements

  • Excellent working knowledge of and production experience with Nuke.

  • Work with multiple render-passes.

  • Excellent organisation, communication and interpersonal skills.

  • A pro-active and collaborative work ethic.

  • A strong eye for detail, composition, colour and lighting.

  • The ability to multitask, prioritise and problem-solve.

  • An understanding of colour space principles.

Desirable Experience

  • Knowledge of practical lighting for photography.

  • Knowledge of the overall VFX pipeline.

  • Experience in dealing and communicating with clients.

  • Programming and coding experience and knowledge.

raw.description:
The multi-Oscar-winning creative Film & Episodic Studio at Framestore has worked with some of the greatest storytellers in film today. Collaborating with directors and producers across the complete filmmaking process to help design, plan and create beautiful images, we focus on finding innovative creative solutions to support their vision and set new standards for visual effects in cinema.

Framestore combines talent and technology to bring life to everything we create. Driven by creativity and inspired by the future, we set out every day to reframe the possible.

About the role

This is an existing role within our team. As a Senior Animator, you'll be a key creative force in breathing life, weight, and personality into complex three-dimensional characters and photorealistic creatures. You’ll jump straight into the heart of our storytelling, crafting everything from nuanced, emotional facial expressions to epic, high-action combat performances. If you have a passion for mastering complex anatomy and love the challenge of making mythical beasts—whether they walk, fly, or breathe fire—feel completely grounded in reality, this is the place to do it.

What you’ll do

  • Collaborate closely with your Animation Lead and Supervisor to produce premium, story-driven animation that elevates the pacing and style of the film.

  • Partner with our Rigging and Pipeline teams, sharing direct feedback to refine character setups, enhance visual quality, and build smoother tool workflows.

  • Animate both primary and secondary characters, ensuring every element in the frame possesses authentic motion and soul.

  • Take ownership of your workflow, keeping production schedules transparent and hitting your deadlines consistently.

  • Mentor and support less senior artists, sharing your craft and helping them grow their skills.

  • Actively tackle creative changes and follow through constructively on supervisor notes and technical feedback.


  • Significant experience animating on large-scale, photorealistic VFX projects, with a showreel that highlights exceptional creature and character performances.

  • Deep production knowledge of Maya.

  • A natural grasp of physical motion, weight, balance, and spatial awareness.

  • A strong foundation in human and animal anatomy, which underpins how you animate complex fantasy muscle structures and locomotion.

  • An understanding of character rigs, animation pipelines, and data transfer between production tools.

  • Clear, constructive communication and a genuinely collaborative approach to working across distributed pipeline teams.

  • Adaptability, an open mind for direction, and a calm, reliable focus when deadlines approach.

You might also have

  • Experience working with, clean-up, or editing of motion capture data.

  • A traditional background in sketching, life drawing, or classic 2D animation.

  • A working knowledge of Modelling or basic scripting (Python/MEL) to streamline workflows.

At Framestore’s Oscar-winning Technology team, innovation is at the heart of what we do, whether this be developing new techniques, new ideas or creative new ways to tell our clients’ stories. Underpinning all of this is a long tradition of research, technology and development - from engineering our bespoke software solutions to gaining early access to bleeding-edge technology and forging vibrant partnerships with leading academic and scientific institutions.

Framestore combines talent and technology to bring life to everything we create. Driven by creativity and inspired by the future, we set out every day to reframe the possible.

About the Role

This is a new, hands-on role within our team. You’ll play a vital part in building the future of our cloud-first and machine learning strategies, writing the core software and automation that drives them. In this role, you will be actively developing high-availability automation workflows and building resilient big data pipelines that scale compute across the business. You will provide cloud and systems support for developers building complex agentic applications, while driving DevOps best practices to ensure our cloud services are built for the future.

You'll drive the evolution of our cloud infrastructure by designing and implementing automation solutions that scale across the organisation. Your work will span cloud-native practices, machine learning infrastructure, and intelligent systems that keep our environment secure, resilient, and cost-effective.

What you’ll do:

  • Build highly available automation workflows and orchestrators that enable distributed builds, cross-platform compute scaling, and deployment of AI agents and data-heavy models

  • Design and implement event-driven automation and self-healing cloud systems that proactively detect, diagnose, and remediate infrastructure anomalies

  • Architect robust cloud security frameworks, identity management, and automated governance baselines across our global footprint

  • Design and optimise big data infrastructure for handling large metadata datasets and media assets, whilst identifying opportunities to reduce infrastructure spend without compromising performance


Essential Skills:

  • Experience designing high-availability, multi-environment cloud infrastructure using IaC (ideally Terraform) and container orchestration

  • Proven track record in the design and management of cloud-based data systems, such as Snowflake or BigQuery

  • A strong software background (ideally Python) with a proven track record of architecting scalable services and APIs

  • Ability to build, scale, and secure distributed automation pipelines (like GitLab CI) focusing on performance, caching, and testing frameworks

  • Experience supporting engineering teams, championing DevSecOps best practices, and collaborating with tech leadership

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between infrastructure engineering and development team workflows

Nice-to-have Skills:

  • Experience designing setups that span cloud providers and local physical servers

  • Knowledge of virtualisation of service applications

  • Advanced monitoring experience using tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, or ELK.

  • A professional-level cloud certification

  • Production experience managing complex Kubernetes clusters and high-scale Docker environments.

  • Experience using advanced data platform features like vector embeddings, clustering, and analytics to enrich large-scale datasets

From the high-stakes energy of live corporate events to the behind-the-scenes magic of maintenance, you'll be the go-to leader making sure every square inch of our space shines. If you're a pro at juggling logistics, inspiring a diverse team, and turning "good" feedback into "where do i sign for next year" status, we want to meet you!   • Commercial & financial management:
    Assisting in the running a profitable venue to help towards the company vision
  • Operational management:

    Maintaining excellent client relations to ensure a successful venue

    Build and maintain an excellent team to deliver the best service

Day to day operations:

  • Direct management of the Events operations team and Conference Services Team and oversee staff rotas
  • To ensure effective communication between all FOH departments and with the wider venue

Looking after our guests:

  • Deliver the highest levels of customer service across all events 
  • Constantly seek and monitor client feedback, ensuring that records are being kept up to date
  • Manage and act upon feedback by providing action plans for improvement
  • To ensure any complaints are dealt with professionally
  • To achieve 90% result in Venue Verdict customer feedback and 9-10 Net Promoter score

Looking after the purse strings:

  • Manage all invoicing and inventory
  • Labour management, ensuring we have the right people in the right places

Learn more at https://convene.com/.

raw.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
  • Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
  • Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
  • Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 

The Kind of Person We're After

  • You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
  • You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
  • You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
  • Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 

What We Offer

  • True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
  • A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
  •  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

 

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance 
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme 
  • Eye Care Vouchers 
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property.
